title: Graph neural network finds ground-state structures of boron- and nitrogen-substituted C60
summary: A graph neural network using the molecular graph and its dual graph predicted binding energies of substituted C60 isomers with an RMSE of 1.713 meV and more than six thousand isomers per second on an eight-core PC. Selected predicted structures were re-optimized by DFT, and new lower-energy structures were found for boron substitution numbers seven to twelve and nitrogen substitution numbers seven to eleven. The work is computational with no synthesis.
ai_technology: Graph neural network on topology and dual-graph ring types predicting binding energy
organization: College of Mathematics, Hohai University, Changzhou, China

evidence.tested: DFT re-optimization of selected predicted stable structures to confirm ground-state configurations.
evidence.unknown: Whether the structures can be synthesized and observed experimentally; full text not reviewed.
